description: What a car through an employer's salary sacrifice scheme really costs a month: the take-home given up plus company car tax on its benefit, against leasing the same car privately. Use for 'is an electric car through salary sacrifice worth it', 'what does a £450 a month EV scheme cost me'.

children.description: Children Child Benefit is claimed for. Defaults to 0.

co2.description: Official CO2 in g/km. Defaults to 0, fully electric.

electricRangeMiles.description: Electric-only range in miles, for a hybrid of 1 to 50 g/km.

listPrice.description: The car's list price with options (P11D value).

monthlySacrifice.description: What the scheme takes from salary for the car, a month - the figure it quotes.

privateMonthly.description: What leasing the same car privately would cost a month, to compare. Optional.

salary.description: Gross salary, in pounds a year.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

studentLoanPlan.description: Undergraduate student loan plan, if any.

name: calculate_ev_salary_sacrifice
title: Electric car salary sacrifice
